name: Canvas Snapshot Diff Tool rubric
mission: Compare two Canvas assignment snapshots and write one human-readable Markdown report of every change (due dates, description edits, point adjustments, removals, additions), grouped by assignment title.

decisions.D1: Real Canvas page captures, stored read-only under snapshots/. Tool runs offline. Selectors pinned against the Dashboard capture now present.
decisions.D2: Each snapshot is a single HTML file; positionals are OLD_HTML (previous) and NEW_HTML (current).
decisions.D3: Exit 2 = cannot open/read input; exit 1 = readable but unparseable.
decisions.D4: No partial report is written when processing fails.
decisions.D5: Human-readable means the pinned header, summary, sections, and bullets; nothing more.
decisions.D6: Report sections in defined order; assignments sorted alphabetically by title.
decisions.D7: Final field scope: title, due date, description, points.
decisions.D8: Proof of concept, 2026-09-23, amends D1/D7: ignore assignment descriptions and ignore partial (non-full-list) captures. Parse whatever assignments the capture shows (title, due date, points where present); do not emit Description edited.
decisions.D9: Proof of concept, 2026-09-24, supersedes the stream-row clause in D1: parser is To-Do-only. An activity-stream row carries the change timestamp, not the assignment's due date or points, so stream-derived records could only produce no-ops, false removals (rolling window), or mislabeled additions. Correctness over speed (charter #1). TC-11 reworded to To-Do scope.

threshold.note: Pass requires weighted score >= 0.80 AND no Material row rated 'Does not meet'. Non-material rows contribute to the score only.
